name: decision
description: An open decision waiting on the assignee's word; body shape per daita-beast protocol

name: workstream
description: Tracking issue of a workstream (one GitHub Project); status reports are its comments

name: hands
description: An act only the assignee can perform (public flip, chain, secret, scope grant)

name: blocked
description: Waiting on a decision or another repo

name: needs-review
description: A pull request waiting on the assignee's word (approve, revise:, reject:); on the decider's board

name: desk
description: A seat's desk: asks and messages as comments; body generated by desk.sh publish

name: rejected
description: A decision or pull request the decider rejected (closed with their reason quoted)

name: bounty
description: Work the owner will award on acceptance; submissions are PRs referencing this issue

name: awarded
description: Carries a BEAST-AWARD comment by a repo admin or maintainer; the ledger reads it
